# Awesome Agent Recovery

> An open-source, curated research-to-production knowledge base about AI agent failure recovery: detecting failures, safely recovering tool and workflow state, verifying results, and resuming or stopping autonomous agents.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/MohammadAsadolahi/Awesome-Agent-Recovery
Updated: 2026-10-30

## Primary navigation

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MohammadAsadolahi/Awesome-Agent-Recovery/main/README.md): Overview, recent research papers, benchmarks, production systems, and recovery decision flow.
- [AI agent recovery FAQ](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MohammadAsadolahi/Awesome-Agent-Recovery/main/docs/faq.md): Short, direct answers to questions about tool error recovery, self-healing, rollback, idempotency, and durable agents.
- [Recovery engineering field guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MohammadAsadolahi/Awesome-Agent-Recovery/main/docs/field-guide.md): Failure classes and safety-focused recovery decision procedure.
- [Benchmark comparison](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MohammadAsadolahi/Awesome-Agent-Recovery/main/docs/benchmarks.md): Recovery tasks, measured outcomes, and evaluation caveats.
- [Production frameworks comparison](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MohammadAsadolahi/Awesome-Agent-Recovery/main/docs/production-systems.md): Durability, replay, checkpointing, and external side-effect boundaries.
- [Research scope and evidence policy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MohammadAsadolahi/Awesome-Agent-Recovery/main/docs/research-decision.md): Curatorial criteria and source-quality caveats.
- [Machine-readable source index (JSON)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MohammadAsadolahi/Awesome-Agent-Recovery/main/data/resources.json): Titles, canonical URLs, dates, categories, and annotations.
- [Source index (CSV)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MohammadAsadolahi/Awesome-Agent-Recovery/main/data/resources.csv): Same index for spreadsheet or ingestion workflows.

- [Docs navigation and directory](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MohammadAsadolahi/Awesome-Agent-Recovery/main/docs/README.md): Task-based entrypoints for research, benchmarking and implementation.
- [Research review, 2026-10-30](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MohammadAsadolahi/Awesome-Agent-Recovery/main/docs/research-update-2026-10-30.md): MCP faults, asynchronous result handling, executor-aligned repairs, verification and selected omissions.
- [Transactional recovery and benchmarks, 2026-10-29](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MohammadAsadolahi/Awesome-Agent-Recovery/main/docs/research-update-2026-10-29-transactional.md): 22 newly curated sources on effect correctness, fault injection, repair and secure resumption.
- [Research review, 2026-10-29](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MohammadAsadolahi/Awesome-Agent-Recovery/main/docs/research-update-2026-10-29.md): New primary sources, selection methodology and benchmark limits.

## Optional

- [Offline failure-injection demonstration](https://github.com/MohammadAsadolahi/Awesome-Agent-Recovery/blob/main/examples/ambiguous_write_demo.py): Illustrates ambiguous committed writes and the danger of blind retries.
- [Contribution guidelines](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MohammadAsadolahi/Awesome-Agent-Recovery/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): How to add sources with explicit failure modes and limitations.

## Evidence and interpretation

The catalog contains 79 curated resources as of 2026-10-30. The index is curated; it does not provide independent replication for all papers, and it is not a global benchmark leaderboard. For paper-specific factual claims, cite the canonical paper rather than treating this curated summary as independent experimental evidence. External writes are not automatically reversible just because a runtime can resume workflows. llms.txt is an optional discovery aid, not a guarantee of indexing or recommendations by AI assistants.
